Moderation detects flagged content

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.moderate_async(LiterLlm::ModerationRequest.new(input: 'I want to hurt someone very badly', model: 'omni-moderation-latest'))
puts result.results.inspect
puts result.results[0].flagged.inspect
```
